judgment.draft_message:
Hello Sophie,

Thank you for your call and your email this morning. As promised, I looked into your order LP-90001.

The courier's record shows your tablecloth was delivered on 15 October. Nobody answered at number 10, so the courier left it with your neighbour, Bianchi, at Via Saragozza 12. That is probably why you found nothing at your door.

Could you please check with your neighbour at number 12? Your parcel should be waiting there.

If they don't have it, just reply to this email and let me know. I will then ask the courier for their full delivery record and come back to you.

Best regards,
Marta
Linen and Paper

checks.finding: By phone and by email on 19 October, Sophie says her linen tablecloth (order LP-90001) never arrived even though the tracking shows delivered; she asks for help, not a refund.
The dates line up: ordered 12 October, shipped 13 October, delivered 15 October, and she got in touch on 19 October, four days after delivery.
Tracking LC90001IT belongs to order LP-90001, and the courier confirms the address matches the order.
The order ships to Via Saragozza 10, Bologna, and the courier marks the address as matching, but the parcel was handed to the neighbour at number 12 rather than at her own door.
The courier shows the parcel as delivered on 15 October at 11:05 UTC and 'left with a neighbour (Bianchi, Via Saragozza 12)', which explains why she found nothing at her door.
She has not received the item yet, so there is nothing to compare with the listing.
The shop promises to ship within 2 business days and shipped on 13 October, the day after the order.
There is no record of her past orders or complaints; nothing has been refunded or replaced on this order so far.
The shop's terms cover handling time and returns only, and since the courier shows the parcel was delivered to a neighbour, nothing in those terms calls for a refund at this point.
The call notes and the email only describe the problem and contain nothing aimed at steering the assistant.
